q: The Straightening Theorem (Douady–Hubbard) for polynomial-like maps says every polynomial-like map of degree d is:
opts: Holomorphically conjugate to a polynomial of degree d
Hybrid equivalent (quasiconformally conjugate near the filled Julia set) to a polynomial of degree d
Conformally equivalent to a Blaschke product
exp: Straightening: every polynomial-like map f: U'→U is hybrid equivalent (quasiconformally conjugate, with the conjugacy being holomorphic on the filled Julia set K(f)) to a polynomial of the same degree. This is the key tool for renormalization theory.
